Green Li-ion (greenli-ion.com), Singapore lithium-ion battery recycling tech company (also a HAX/SOSV portfolio company). Disclosed equity ≈ $39.6M: $3.45M seed led by LiNiCo (2021), $11.55M Series A led by Energy Revolution Ventures (Apr 2022), $20.5M pre-Series B led by TRIREC (Mar 2023, $187M post-money), $4.1M from PETRONAS' Twin Towers Ventures (Sep 2023), plus an undisclosed bridge led by Laurence Escalante (May 2025). Planned full Series B not publicly closed.
